heading: Friday, June 26, 2026
topLine: OpenAI previews GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna.

items.headline: OpenAI previews GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna
items.summary: The GPT-5.6 family has three tiers: flagship Sol, lower-cost Terra and fastest Luna. It first went to a limited group of trusted partners at the US government's request, then became generally available in ChatGPT, Codex and the API on July 9; OpenAI rated all three High capability in cybersecurity and bio/chem.
